title: Stress-Testing ML Pipelines with Adversarial Data Corruption
reasoning: The paper introduces a technical framework called Savage for stress-testing ML pipelines by generating structured data corruption. While the experiments use fairness metrics (like demographic parity) and address 'fairness-aware learning' to test robustness, the paper's core focus is on data quality and pipeline engineering rather than evaluating religious, spiritual, or philosophical moral/ethical systems.
